title: Code and data for: The value of grid-connection information in bridge-power planning for AI data centres
description: Model, run definitions, analysis code, derived results and the job-level run archive (runs.zip) behind the paper 'The value of grid-connection information in bridge-power planning for AI data centres'. A multistage stochastic mixed-integer program plans on-site bridge power (gas combined cooling, heat and power, diesel and rented gensets, a battery and purchased standby) for a 150 MW AI campus before its grid-connection quarter is known, and values a utility's connection-date forecast by exact evaluation under declared forecast-error laws. Code: MIT licence. Data and results: CC BY 4.0.
